about: Classes of the 1,001 entries of the GlycoShape database (published inventory GLYCOSHAPE.json of 2026-08-27, without Level 3) as decided by the rule-based classifier of the thesis (figures/GlycoShape/scripts/coverage_classes.py, data/coverage.json): class, subclass, and for N-glycans the number of antennae and whether there is a core fucose. published_keywords are the class keywords the database carried before lib/glyclass.py (string patterns). open_to_argument lists the entries whose class depends on the order of the rules or matches none of the named groups (data/coverage-classes.json).

entries.subclass: N-glycan with a core that is not Man(b1-4)GlcNAc(b1-4)GlcNAc
